children: Trekking, safaris, dive trips and expedition cruises — planned one-to-one by people who’ve been there, so all you have to do is show up and go.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: You plan with someone who has actually walked the pass, dived the reef or tracked the migration — not a call-center script reading from the same brochure.
Travelling alone, as a couple or with a whole crew, we build the trip around your pace and your people — never a bus of forty strangers.
We work with local guides, camps and operators who look after the places we send you — so your trip leaves them better, not busier.
Permits, transfers, gear lists, altitude, timing the seasons — the hundred fiddly details are ours to sort. You get the adventure without the admin.

Then your specialist builds the route: the right season, the right guides, the logistics that make a big trip feel effortless. You review, we refine, and only when it’s exactly right do you book.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Trailhead Travel is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A hiker on a ridgeline above a wide mountain valley at sunrise

children: We started Trailhead because the best trips of our lives were never the ones we booked off a shelf — they were the ones someone who’d been there helped us build. So that’s what we do, all day: plan real adventures for people who want more than a package.

We’re travellers first. Between us we’ve trekked the big passes, dived the far reefs, tracked the migration and sailed to both poles. That first-hand knowledge is the whole point — it’s the difference between a trip that works and a trip you’ll never forget.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every specialist plans in the region they know first-hand — not from a brochure, from boots on the ground.
Your pace, your budget, your must-dos. We shape the trip to fit, then refine it until it’s exactly right.
Good for the places we love
Local guides and operators, sustainable choices, and travel that gives back to the destinations we send you to.
